{{Quote|See? I'm flesh and blood, just like you.|Waxer, to Numa|audio=FleshAndBlood-IoR.flac|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
'''Waxer''' was the nickname of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]], a [[Company/Legends|unit]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Waxer fought alongside [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], participating in the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|liberation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and its [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] inhabitants. During the battle, Waxer and fellow [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Boil/Legends|Boil]] found a [[Youngling/Legends|young]] Twi'lek orphan named [[Numa/Legends|Numa]] in one of the city's alleys. Waxer took compassion on the [[Gender/Legends|girl]] and convinced Boil to take her with them as they traveled through the city in order to protect her from harm.

Waxer's kindness toward Numa proved advantageous for the Republic forces, as the girl showed them secret underground passages through the city. The passages allowed Ghost Company to succeed in their mission to destroy [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[J-1 semi-autonomous proton cannon|proton cannons]] that were preventing a Republic landing. After the successful liberation of Ryloth, Waxer participated in the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], where he and Boil assisted the Republic in shutting down major Separatist [[Geonosis primary droid foundry|battle droid foundries]] and at one point rescued Kenobi, whose [[Bad Kitty/Legends|landing gunship]] had been shot down by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] forces.

Later in the war, alongside the 212th, Waxer participated in a [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Republic campaign]] to retake [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], where he assisted [[General/Legends|General]] Kenobi in capturing the planet's [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|capital city]]. Waxer [[Platoon leader/Legends|led]] a [[Waxer's platoon|platoon]] of 212th troopers to the site of a supposed upcoming attack by the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]], having been warned by General [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] that that the enemy would be wearing captured [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]]. Waxer's men indeed engaged enemy forces in [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]], only to discover them to have been fellow 501st troopers; the two squads had been pitted against each other by Krell, who was planning to join the Separatists and sought to thwart the Republic's progress in the battle. Although Krell's ruse was exposed before the two clone detachments fully destroyed each other, Waxer himself was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Lightfight|firefight]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="Databank" /> the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] nicknamed "Waxer" was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="TCWCE" /> to fight in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Databank" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Waxer served under [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] in [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]], a [[Company/Legends|unit]] of the Grand Army of the Republic's [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]]. While serving in that unit, Waxer became best friends with a fellow [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] named [[Boil/Legends|Boil]].<ref name="Encyclopedia Waxer">{{SWE|characters|waxer|Waxer}}</ref>

===Ryloth===
====Landing on Ryloth====
{{Quote|Send your best men to scout ahead.''"<br />"''Will do, sir. Boil, Waxer, come with me.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Cody, selecting Waxer and Boil to scout out Nabat|audio=BoilWaxerBestMen-IoR.flac|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
[[File:Ghost_company.png|thumb|right|300px|Waxer, alongside the rest of Ghost Company, aboard the ''Crumb Bomber'']]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Innocents Date">{{TCWdates|120}}</ref> after [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] took control of the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and subjugated its [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] inhabitants, the Republic mounted an [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|offensive]] to liberate the Twi'leks. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], were able to destroy the Separatist [[Ryloth blockade/Legends|blockade]] surrounding the planet, allowing the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] to land and initiate a [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground assault]].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref> Alongside [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> and [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]]<ref name="tfu">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Cody, Boil, and the rest of Ghost Company, Waxer boarded an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]]<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />&mdash;the [[Crumb Bomber/Legends|''Crumb Bomber'']]<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode020.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref>&mdash;which set off for the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]].<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

Aboard the [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]], Kenobi and Cody instructed Ghost Company to utilize their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|EMP grenades]] only, in order to avoid destroying the Twi'leks' home during their attempt to free them. Meanwhile, Separatist [[J-1 semi-autonomous proton cannon]]s below began to harass the Republic [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]], forcing them to pull back. Aboard one of the [[Transport/Legends|transports]], Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] used a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] to contact Kenobi and tasked him and Ghost Company with destroying the [[Proton cannon/Legends|cannons]] to allow the rest of the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to land. After reaching the planet's surface, the Republic forces were confronted by a group of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] in a bunker on the outskirts of Nabat. Kenobi led Waxer and Boil closer to the bunker in order to use [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|EMP]] [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] and disable the [[Battle droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

After Waxer's first attempt to lob a grenade into the bunker failed due to the long distance,<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth Director's Cut">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}} {{C|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|Director's Cut]] version}}</ref> Kenobi used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|guide]] Waxer's and Boil's grenades and helped them reach their target. With the bunker neutralized, Ghost Company entered the city. Kenobi then told Cody to pick his best men and [[Scout/Legends|scout]] ahead. Following Kenobi's orders, Cody selected Waxer, Boil, and a trooper named [[Wooley/Legends|Wooley]]. While scouting, the clones took notice that the city was deserted; the Twi'leks had been driven from their homes by the [[Confederacy military/Legends|Confederate forces]]. Cody suggested that the group should split up and ordered Waxer and Boil to go south&mdash;telling them to return by an appointed [[Time/Legends|time]]&mdash;while he and Wooley checked a courtyard.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

====Meeting Numa====
{{Quote|We should do something. I say we take her with us.|Waxer, to Boil, concerning Numa|audio=ISayWeTakeHerWithUs-IoR.flac|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
Separated from Cody, Waxer and Boil stumbled upon the [[Youngling/Legends|young]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Twi'lek orphan [[Numa/Legends|Numa]]<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth Ep Guide" /> in an alley. Waxer wanted to take her with them, but Boil insisted that she would only slow them down. As the two started to argue, Waxer spotted a Separatist [[Separatist probe droid/Legends|recon droid]] flying nearby. By hiding in the alley, the clones managed to remain undetected by the [[Probe droid/Legends|droid]], but its appearance prompted Boil to hurry Waxer. The latter continued to insist on taking Numa with them and soon convinced Boil to do so. As Boil reached to Numa, however, she bit his [[Limb/Legends|finger]], leading Waxer to believe that she must have mistaken the two for droids.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

[[File:Waxer_Numa.png|thumb|left|300px|Waxer comforts Numa.]]
To ease the girl's fears, Waxer removed his [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] and tried to explain to Numa that he and Boil were [[Species/Legends|living beings]], just like her. Noticing that Numa looked starved, Boil and Waxer gave her a [[Ration bar/Legends|ration bar]]. After tasting the [[Foodstuff/Legends|bar]], the girl called the clones "nerra," a [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]] word unknown to Waxer and Boil. The clones then returned to their scouting mission, and Numa followed them. Soon, however, Numa ran away in the direction of the recon [[Droid/Legends|droid]], and Waxer, unwilling to let her be [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the droids, decided to follow her, much to Boil's dismay. The girl led the two clones to her destroyed [[Numa's home/Legends|home]],<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> where Waxer noticed a [[Tooka doll/Legends|tooka doll]]<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth Ep Guide" /> lying on the floor. After he gave the [[Doll/Legends|doll]] to Numa, she began to cry, and the two clones comforted her.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

The two troopers received an incoming transmission from Cody and realized that they were late. Boil wanted to answer the transmission, but Waxer stopped him and asked how they would explain their delay to the [[Commander/Legends|commander]]. Waxer then told Boil that it would be better if they hurried back to the Republic position and claimed that they had ran into trouble, lying that their communications had been jammed as further cover. Before the clones could get very far, however, several [[Gutkurr/Legends|gutkurrs]]&mdash;[[Diet/Legends|predatory]] beasts released by the Separatists to fight the Republic forces&mdash;attacked them, and they were forced to retreat with Numa back into the home.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

====Liberating the Twi'leks====
{{Dialogue|Cody|Waxer, Boil, where have you two slackers been?|Boil|Sir, there is an explanation.|Waxer|We got sidetracked.|Kenobi|line4=no|[notices Numa] "''I think I see what sidetracked you.''"|attr=Waxer and Boil try to explain their delay to Kenobi and Commander Cody|audio=WeGotDistracted-IoR.flac|src=<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
[[File:Numa_leads_Waxer_and_Boil.png|thumb|right|300px|Numa helped Waxer and Boil reach their unit.]]
To escape the creatures, Numa led the clones into an underground passage, and they resurfaced near Kenobi, Cody, and the rest of Ghost Company, who had just fought off a number of gutkurrs themselves. Conversing to Numa in Twi'leki, Kenobi discovered that she could lead them through secret passages to the Twi'lek [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], who were trapped at the courtyard near the proton [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]]. While Cody and the rest of his company created a diversion to distract the droids, Waxer and Boil went with Kenobi to free the hostages.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

The three were successful in their mission and liberated the Twi'leks, who then took cover in the secret passage. There, Numa was reunited with her uncle,<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> [[Nilim Bril/Legends|Nilim Bril]].<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth Ep Guide" /> Kenobi then took control of one of the proton cannons and with the help of Waxer and Boil&mdash;who loaded the cannon with shells&mdash;managed to destroy the other cannons. However, a shot from Separatist [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20's]] [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] destroyed the commandeered cannon and blasted the three aside.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

Numa, worried for her new friends, ran from her cover to the clones, and after they had recovered, she ran over to Kenobi. TX-20's [[Tank/Legends|tank]] targeted Numa and Kenobi, but the now-freed Twi'leks attacked the [[Tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] and destroyed him. Mace Windu and the transports were then able to land. As the Republic forces prepared to head to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]] to retake it and free the planet, Waxer and Boil said goodbye to Numa and bid her well. Numa then called them "nerra" one last time, and Kenobi translated for them: "nerra" meant "brother."<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> Eventually, the Republic was able to liberate Ryloth and destroy all of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid forces]].<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref><ref name="Republic Heroes">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>

===Geonosis===
{{Quote|Why do we always get the fun missions?''"<br />"''Oh, this isn't the fun part. Getting back to the square is the fun part.|Waxer and Boil|audio=OhThisIsntTheFunPart-LandingAtPointRain.flac|<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" />}}
Later in the war, the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] population of the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]&mdash;the site of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle]] of the war&mdash;rebelled against the Republic and began producing droids for the Confederacy in newly established [[Geonosis primary droid foundry|droid foundries]]. Upon [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia/Legends|discovering]] that fact, the Republic launched an [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|assault]] on the planet in the hopes of capturing the Geonosian leader, [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], and destroying the newly [[Ray shield/Legends|ray-shielded]] [[Factory/Legends|foundries]].<ref name="Landing at Point Rain">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>

[[File:Arf_waxer_boil.png|thumb|left|300px|Waxer and Boil in ARF trooper gear on Geonosis]]
The Republic forces were divided into three groups, led by Jedi Generals Kenobi, Skywalker, and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], and set off in LAAT/i gunships to a rendezvous point, where they were to regroup for the assault on the [[Ray shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. Waxer and Boil accompanied the strike team led by Kenobi and Commander Cody, and the assault force soon managed to reach the rendezvous point despite heavy fire from the Geonosians. Upon landing, Cody circled his [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] into a defensive formation, and the clone troopers engaged the enemy Geonosians. However, it was soon discovered that during the landing procedure, Kenobi's gunship<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" />&mdash;the [[Bad Kitty/Legends|''Bad Kitty'']]&mdash;had been shot down and crashed five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away from his forces' position.<ref name="Landing at Point Rain Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode205.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>

Hoping to rescue the [[General/Legends|general]], Cody called Waxer and Boil and ordered them to reach Kenobi's gunship and check it for survivors. The two troopers raced through the ongoing [[Lightfight|firefight]] to the downed vehicle and opened the gunship. Inside it, they found two survivors: the injured Kenobi and clone trooper [[Trapper (clone trooper)/Legends|Trapper]]. Under covering fire from the Republic's AT-TE walkers, Waxer and Boil escorted the wounded pair back to Cody's position, where Waxer stayed with Obi-Wan as the commander briefed the situation. Later, Skywalker's and Mundi's troops&mdash;along with several [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] dispatched by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]&mdash;arrived to assist Kenobi's men. Waxer remained by his general's side as he explained the plan to destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], which was successful.<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" /> At some point during the battle, the Republic forces targeted one of the Geonosian weapons factories for destruction. Waxer was then dispatched to scout ahead and gather information about the enemy. He ran into a group of battle droids but was able to take them down before they revealed his position.<ref name="Hasbro Set">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=(Target Exclusive) ARF Trooper Waxer and Battle Droid|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWEXWaxer-BD.asp}}</ref>

===Umbara===
{{Quote|Tell me who gave you the orders to attack us.''"<br />[gasping] "''It&hellip; It was General Krell.''" [coughing] "''He sent us to these coordinates to stop the enemy. We thought they were wearing our armor, but it was&hellip;you.|CT-7567 and the dying Waxer|audio=Waxer-death.flac|<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />}}
By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Waxer had achieved the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper lieutenant]].<ref name="Lieutenant Waxer note">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' establishes that [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] were [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper lieutenant]]. Since "[[Carnage of Krell]]" portrays Waxer as being the [[Platoon leader/Legends|leader]] of a [[Waxer's platoon|platoon]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], he must have been a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] during the events of the episode.</ref> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Umbaran/Legends|native population]] of the planet [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] seceded from the Republic and pledged their support to the Confederacy,<ref name="Encyclopedia: Umbara">{{SWE|locations|umbara|Umbara}}</ref> prompting the Galactic Republic to launch an [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|offensive]] to retake the strategically located planet. As the Republic forces, led by Generals Skywalker, Kenobi, [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], and [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]], closed in on the world, Waxer attended the pre-battle briefing held among the command staff aboard an ''Acclamator''-class transport. Waxer and the 212th Attack Battalion, under the command of Kenobi, was tasked with capturing the planet's [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|capital city]], while the rest of the troops provided support for that main assault.<ref name="Darkness on Umbara">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref> As the lengthy battle dragged on, the 212th received a message from General Krell, who had assumed command of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of clone troopers after Skywalker was recalled from Umbara. Krell warned the 212th that the Umbarans, wearing captured [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]], were planning an attack.<ref name="Carnage of Krell">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref>

[[File:WaxersLastMoments-CoK.png|thumb|right|300px|Waxer shedding a tear, upon realizing that he killed his own brothers]]
Waxer then [[Platoon leader/Legends|led]] a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of the 212th's men to the coordinates provided by Krell, where they indeed encountered a group of attackers in clone [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. Heavy fighting erupted between the two groups, during which many troops on both sides were killed and Waxer himself was fatally wounded. However, Waxer's men soon discovered that they were killing their own brethren from the 501st when one of the opposing soldiers&mdash;[[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex"&mdash;took off his helmet and ran out to the middle of the battlefield in a desperate attempt to stop the fight.<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />

The 501st, via a fake transmission from Waxer engineered by Krell&mdash;who had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and intended to join [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] of the Separatists&mdash;had been guided to the same location and had similarly been warned about a disguised enemy. Pitting the two clone detachments against each other was another step in Krell's plan to ensure the Republic's defeat on Umbara. After Rex successfully broke the battle, he walked to the dying Waxer's side, who informed him about Krell's [[Treason/Legends|treachery]]. With a shocking realization that he had just killed several of his clone brothers, Waxer drew his final breath and died.<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Oh, you made a friend. Mission accomplished.|Boil, to Waxer, regarding Numa|audio=MissionAccomplished-IoR.flac|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
[[File:Waxer_and_Boil_comfort_Numa.png|thumb|left|300px|Waxer found place for compassion amid the horrors of the war.]]
During his mission on Ryloth, Waxer was eager for combat.<ref name="Action figure">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=Battle Pack|pack=Assault on Ryloth|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWBPAssaultonRyloth.asp}}</ref> Although he had been hardened by the Clone Wars,<ref name="NDS Republic Heroes">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition in-game databank}}</ref> Waxer was nevertheless a very compassionate [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], showing considerable concern about Numa's well-being and an amiable manner toward her. Although he and Boil were the best of friends,<ref name="Encyclopedia Waxer" /> Waxer was often rather annoyed at Boil, who initially did not care for Numa or Ryloth's locals. Waxer also showed a fair amount of disobedience by deliberately deciding not to answer a call from command and planning on lying to his superior about running into trouble and having his communications jammed. According to Kenobi, it was uncharacteristic for Waxer and Boil to be late.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> During the Second Battle of Geonosis, Waxer was sarcastic regarding his and Boil's assignment to rescue Kenobi, complaining that they always got the "fun" missions.<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" /> When Waxer discovered that he had killed other clones on Umbara, he was deeply affected by it, shedding a single tear before he died.<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />

As a clone of Jango Fett, Waxer stood at a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] (or 6 [[Foot/Legends|feet]]).<ref name="TCWCE" /> The trooper had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin, and his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were brown in color.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> Waxer had his [[Hair/Legends|hair]] shaved clean for quicker grooming, but had brown eyebrows and a soul patch beard. He enjoyed teasing Boil about his "fancy" mustache,<ref name="TCWCE" /> who believed himself to be the tougher of the pair.<ref name="Encyclopedia Waxer" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|I guess we're the best.|Boil, on himself and Waxer|audio=IGuessWereTheBest-InnocentsOfRyloth.flac|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
Trained in combat, reconnaissance, and military tactics,<ref name="TCWCE" /> Waxer was a veteran of several major battles of the Clone Wars, including the Battle of Ryloth and the Second Battle of Geonosis.<ref name="Encyclopedia Waxer" /> By the time of the latter battle, Waxer had joined the ranks of [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force troopers]], a specialized branch of clone troopers focused on reconnaissance.<ref name="TCWCE" /> Proficient with a variety of weapons,<ref name="Hasbro Set" /><ref name="Action figure" /> Waxer dispatched a large number of Confederate droids throughout his military career,<ref name="Carnage of Krell guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/carnage-of-krell-episode-guide|text="Carnage of Krell" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> and he had achieved the rank of lieutenant by the time of the Battle of Umbara<ref name="Lieutenant Waxer note" /> and commanded a platoon of troopers.<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />

==Equipment==
[[File:WaxerPh1-SWE.png|thumb|right|300px|Waxer in his customized kill-marked helmet on Ryloth]]
During his mission to Ryloth, Waxer wore standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with Ghost Company's orange markings painted on it.<ref name="TCWCE" /> By that time, Waxer's helmet was adorned with twenty-one tally marks&mdash;eight on the right side and thirteen on the left, along with a drawing of a B1-Series battle droid, reflecting the number of droids he had destroyed.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> On Geonosis, Waxer sported ARF trooper gear, also decorated with his unit's colors.<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" /> Both on Ryloth<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> and on Geonosis, he made use of a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]].<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" />

His equipment also included a pair of [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]]<ref name="Action figure" /> and a [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]] featuring a built-in [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]].<ref name="Hasbro Set" /> By the time of the battle on Umbara, Waxer had switched to Phase II clone trooper armor,<ref name="Carnage of Krell" /> and he continued to keep count of the destroyed battle droids on his helmet and shoulder pad, which now totaled eighty. Waxer also added a cartoon illustration of Numa to his helmet in honor of the Twi'lek girl.<ref name="Carnage of Krell guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Character development===
{{Quote|That was our first tear ''[on ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']''.''"<br />"''That's right. The first time we ever had a character cry. Not just look like they're about to cry, but actually, physically cry, with one tear. And that was all Joel ''[Aron]''.|Animation supervisor [[Keith Kellogg]] and supervising director [[Dave Filoni]] discussing the scene of Waxer's death|audio=Waxer-tear.flac|<ref name="Umbara Commentary">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Four|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Four]]</ref>}}
Waxer was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and first appeared in [[The Clone Wars 1|''The Clone Wars'' 1]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and illustrated by [[Scott Hepburn]]<ref name="Slaves 1">[[The Clone Wars 1|''The Clone Wars'' 1]]</ref> and published on [[September 10]], [[2008]] as a tie-in to the series.<ref name="TCW 1 DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/15-679/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-1|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars #1}}</ref> Waxer then made an appearance in the twentieth episode of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], titled "[[Innocents of Ryloth]]"<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> and which aired on [[March 6]], [[2009]].<ref name="TCW Ep Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> He continued to make appearances on the show until he was killed off in the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] episode "[[Carnage of Krell]],"<ref name="Carnage of Krell" /> which originally aired on [[November 18]], [[2011]].<ref name="TCW Ep Guide" /> That episode featured a scene of Waxer crying, being the first character to do so on the show.<ref name="Umbara Commentary" />

Like all clones in the show, Waxer was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth Ep Guide" /> [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]], the [[Star Wars home video releases|DVD and Blu-ray release]] of the television series' first season,<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth Director's Cut" /> which was released on [[November 9]], 2009,<ref name="tcw s1 date">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20090715.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One on DVD and Blu-Ray}}</ref> featured an extended, "Director's Cut," version of "Innocents of Ryloth." Compared to the original version, it included several new scenes. One scene featured Waxer as he tried to throw a grenade into the droid bunker and missed the target, explaining why Kenobi had to use the Force to guide the subsequent grenades in the aired cut of the episode.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth Director's Cut" />

===Inconsistencies===
====Slaves of the Republic adaptation====
{{Quote|Sir, we're still mopping up clankers here and there, but we've secured the city's north quadrant.|Waxer reports to Obi-Wan Kenobi during the battle at Kiros in ''The Clone Wars'' comic series|<ref name="Slaves 1" />}}
[[File:Waxer.jpg|thumb|right|120px|Waxer's appearance on Kiros in ''The Clone Wars'' comic series]]
The fourth season of the television series also saw the ''Slaves of the Republic'' story arc of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' comic series]] adapted to the screen.<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref> However, as Waxer had just died in the previous episode,<ref name="Carnage of Krell" /> his role during the [[Battle of Kiros]]<ref name="Slaves 1" /> was filled by Boil in the episode "[[Kidnapped]],"<ref name="Kidnapped" /> which aired on [[November 25]], 2011.<ref name="TCW Ep Guide" /> The television series is therefore given [[canon]]ical precedence, and this article assumes that Boil participated in the Battle of Kiros instead of Waxer.

In the comic series, Waxer is featured among the Republic troops dispatched to liberate the [[Togruta/Legends|Togrutan]] [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] world of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], which has been occupied by the Separatists. Led by Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Ahsoka Tano, the Republic forces quickly secure the northern quadrant of Kiros's capital and reach the [[Governor's tower/Legends|headquarters]] of the Separatist commander, [[Xerius Ugg]]. As Commander Cody and the rest of Ghost Company approach from the south through minimal resistance, Waxer reports to General Kenobi on the progress of the battle. The battle is ultimately won by the Republic.<ref name="Slaves 1" />

====Innocents of Ryloth adaptations====
Waxer was featured in the 2009 young-readers book [[The Clone Wars: The Battle for Ryloth|''The Battle for Ryloth'']], which adapted "Innocents of Ryloth" but featured several inconsistencies with the episode. In the book, both Waxer and Boil initially hesitate to take Numa with them but ultimately decide to do so and then take her straight to Kenobi, skipping the gutkurr chase entirely.<ref name="The Battle of Ryloth book">''[[The Clone Wars: The Battle for Ryloth]]''</ref>

A much more glaring inconsistency is presented in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition of the 2009 [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'', which features Waxer as a playable character during the events of "Innocents of Ryloth" but shows an entirely different version of events compared to the TV series. In ''Republic Heroes'', Waxer teams up with Ahsoka Tano to destroy the proton cannons. The two advance through the streets of one of Ryloth's settlements, fighting B1 battle droids and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] along the way and working together to activate switches and open doors.<ref name="Rep Heroes DS">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version}}</ref>

Just near the plaza where the proton cannons are located, Waxer and Tano are temporarily stopped by a [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielded]] [[Turret/Legends|turret]] but manage to deactivate its shield by overloading the nearby [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]]. After destroying the turret, Waxer and Tano find out that the entrance to the plaza is sealed. They contact General Kenobi&mdash;who, along with Commander Cody, is advancing from the other side of the town&mdash;and request his assistance. Kenobi soon arrives, helps Tano to open the gates, and the two Jedi successfully destroy the cannons.<ref name="Rep Heroes DS" /> This article assumes this portrayal of events to be non-canon.

===Non-canon adaptations===
[[File:Legowaxer.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Waxer right after hitting a gutkurr on the head with a rocket launcher in ''LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars'']]
In 2011, Waxer was featured in the non-canon video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' as one of the playable characters in the level adapting "Innocents of Ryloth." While the Nintendo DS version closely follows the plot of "Innocents of Ryloth," other console versions of the game present a very different take on the events from the television episode. In those versions, Waxer and Boil's encounter with Numa was completely omitted. Instead, they accompany Kenobi and Cody throughout the whole mission, participating in the fight against the gutkurrs, with Waxer using a [[Missile/Legends|rocket]] launcher as his weapon.<ref name="Lego TCW">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>

The game also features a series of "bounty hunter" missions, which involve the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro the Hutt]] sending a team of [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] to capture important Republic figures, intending to receive a [[Ransom/Legends|ransom]] for them. Waxer is one of the possible kidnapping targets and has to be captured by the player character on Ryloth. During the mission, Waxer is situated above the player character's position, firing at the bounty hunter while using a box as cover. The player character has to destroy the supports underneath the box in order to make it and Waxer fall down to the ground, which completes the mission for the player.<ref name="Lego TCW" />
